Introduction
Thank you in advance for helping me out with this research for my Master Thesis for the TU Delft. This survey should take you about 30 minutes after which your credentials and your availability for a short 20-min validation interview will be asked. {br}{br} This study is about the scope change process in bouwteams and its consequences for realization under either UAV-gc or UAV in which liabilities and responsibilities differ significantly from the bouwteam phase. To investigate the bouwteam process and its consequences during realisation, a Q-method is performed. The goal is to find shared perspectives among experts in the field of interest, not resulting in factual knowledge, but in relational and subjective perspectives that will form the basis for the development of a tool to improve scope change control in bouwteam projects. {br}{br} {b}IMPORTANT{/b}.
